I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-random message. I said the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats, not the number they posted in #north-team this morning. As they asked, I did nothing else.

A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it was fine to repeat in that channel. I didn't change their earlier post in #north-team or add a correction there. If people there might use the wrong number, Ilse may want to fix it there too.
